triggerReason: The persistent experiment platform could replay and branch runs, but it did not yet turn observations into falsifiable improvement experiments with human promotion and rollback.
action: Added persisted improvement proposals, executable specifications, isolated baseline/candidate policy forks, threshold evaluation, quality evidence, admin approval, canary monitoring, rollback triggers, and an immutable decision log.
outcome: Self-iteration is now a constrained experiment workflow. Candidates cannot mutate the source run, and only verified, human-approved, healthy canaries reach promoted state.
evidence: The same full promotion workflow passes with memory and PostgreSQL repositories
Baseline and candidate use identical source tick, seed, and horizon
Target improvement, protected-metric regression, replay, invariants, and security gates are recorded
Only admin can approve, start, or observe a canary
Every state transition appends a monotonic immutable decision record
EvolutionLog displays live controlled iteration state
